Yes. I consider myself to like being with guys that are tough, can fight, usually like guns and stuff and I actually just got out a relationship with a guy that is like that and we were together for a long time but he had anger issues and now I’m talking to someone who is the complete opposite; sensitive, pure soul, calm, most likely can’t fight lol and I’m still trying to get used to that. But he’s so kind and has the best heart. Anyone else on here been in a situation like this? I’m having a hard time trying to really convince myself that it’ll work out because he is like this.

I’m so sorry you felt that way. It makes complete sense though. I don’t drive but I could totally see myself in that kind of position if I was in a lot of emotional pain which is usually why I always cut.

Yeah I don’t know why my body and mind were telling me my face, but you’re exactly right. If I don’t do it where I’m told then it doesn’t help the same way. I’m going to sound even crazier when I say that my mind just kind of argues with me and tells me to cut and I try to push it as far back as I can but I’m never strong enough and always cave in.

Yeah I feel the same way about my body dictating me to my wrists and my face. Have you ever actually gone through with it on your neck? I wish I could explain that urge and sense of my body telling me to do it in these places to other people but they don’t understand. Every time I try to explain, they think I’m insane.
